Speaker: Zephyr
Text: Another group of travelers. The Luminous Spire sees many, but few make it this high.

Speaker: Kael
Text: We need to reach the deeper ethereal. The Fade.

Speaker: Zephyr
Text: Wind-walking. That's how you cross the great distances here. I can carry your group on the currents.

Speaker: Zephyr
Text: In return, I ask only one thing — show me the sky from your world. I've heard it's... still.
